subject: Genetics
title: Histone Modification
description: A short lesson to help you apply Histone Modification.

hook.text: Your DNA wraps around protein spools called histones. Loosen the spool, gene turns on. Tighten it, gene goes dark.

buildup.text: Two meters of DNA fits in a tiny nucleus because it winds around histone octamers—like thread on a bobbin.

discovery.text: Chemical tags on histone tails—acetyl, methyl, phosphate—change how tightly DNA wraps.

climax.text: Histone acetylation opens chromatin for reading. Deacetylation closes it.

punchline.text: Loosen the spool: gene on. Tighten it: gene off.

quiz.question: What are histones?
options: Protein spools that DNA wraps around
